description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController. It provides several HTTP GET endpoints: a welcome message at '/', a redirect to Swagger UI at '/docs', a health check at '/health', and application info at '/api/info'. The class is annotated with Swagger/OpenAPI tags for documentation purposes.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints for the notesbackend application, including welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and info endpoints.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message string when the root URL '/' is accessed.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Builds and redirects to the Swagger UI URL, preserving the original request's scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple 'OK' string indicating the application's health status.
